facts.fact: According to Nielsen Media Lab (as cited by the page), audio ads have a 24% higher recall rate than traditional display ads.
facts.quote: According to Nielsen Media Lab, audio ads have a [24% higher recall](https://ads.spotify.com/en-SG/news-and-insights/the-power-of-audio-chapter-2/) rate than traditional display ads.

facts.fact: Audio ads are usually either 15 or 30 seconds long, per the vendor's best-practice guidance.
facts.quote: Audio ads are usually either 15 or 30 seconds long.

facts.fact: The page predicts that by 2022 the average time spent listening to digital audio should rise to 1 hour and 37 minutes per day (eMarketer prediction cited by the page).
facts.quote: it’s predicted that by 2022, the average time spent listening to digital audio should rise to [1 hour and 37 minutes](https://content-na1.emarketer.com/impressive-resilience-of-digital-audio) per day.

facts.fact: On the StackAdapt platform, adding display, video, or CTV to an audio campaign lifted performance by anywhere from 12% to 81%, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: On the StackAdapt platform, we’ve found that when display, video, or CTV is added to an audio campaign, performance is lifted by anywhere from 12% to 81%.

facts.fact: Programmatic audio metrics include cost per completed listen, audio completion (AC), audio completion rate (ACR), and quartile AC.
facts.quote: Metrics include cost per completed listen, audio completion (AC), audio completion rate (ACR), quartile AC and more.

facts.fact: Audio is especially popular among millennials and Gen Z, according to Edison Research's The Infinite Dial 2020 report as cited by the page.
facts.quote: Audio is especially popular among [millennials and Gen Z](http://www.edisonresearch.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/The-Infinite-Dial-2020-U.S.-Edison-Research.pdf), who are entering, or already in, their prime spending years.
